text:
oliver: Quick heads-up — stream dry-run in 8m. we had a last-minute slide swap, so please don't advance slides until i say go. also planning a short lightning Q&A after roadmap (6m).

tanya: noted. mic on lectern is a bit noisy, i'll switch to handheld for the first 2 speakers.

ash: noticed the recorder container on recorder-1 is throwing `BufferOverflow` warnings in the logs. i'll rotate the disk and restart the recorder now.

devops-bot: disk-rotate job queued (id: dr-2026-03-188765). estimated downtime 45s.

ash: recorder back up. log snippet: `recorder[pid=4421]: rotated /var/log/stream/rec-2026-03-188765.log` no frames lost during rotate.

zoe: good call on handheld mics. can anyone confirm captions pipeline is hooked to the right audio feed? last time captions lagged when using podium.

ash: captions were pointing to mixbus-0 (podium) — switched to mixbus-1 (handheld) and restarted captioner.

oliver: thanks. can we also make a single clip of leadership Q&A highlights? @zoe could you timestamp? put markers in the live doc.

zoe: will do. i'll use the clip utility `clipper --live --mark qa_start,qa_end` and paste timestamps in https://docs.internal/allhands/highlights once done.

ash: slight network jitter detected from colo-3 toward cdn-primary, bumped retransmit timeout and enabled provider-failover. monitoring for 2m.

devops-bot: provider-failover triggered -> edge-failover-2 (id: pf-188765-a).

tanya: if failover happens, OBS scene might need to switch to backup ingest URL. i'll queue the scene switch to keybind F12.

oliver: good plan. final ask — keep questions short, we'll pick 4 quick ones and capture longer asks in #product-followup. see you all in 6. :white_check_mark:
